commands:
set -euo pipefail
BRANCH=work/photomap-straighten-20260912
BASE=eca60d3932ef1ab3ad2f99957a4271eab3e8c77b
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$BASE"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git switch --detach "$BASE"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE"
cd frontend
npx prettier --write e2e/visual/admin-guide-detail-race.spec.ts e2e/visual/admin-guide-mutation-race.spec.ts e2e/visual/admin-place-photo-review-lock.spec.ts e2e/visual/admin-queue-race.spec.ts e2e/visual/memory-owner-delete-race.spec.ts src/components/admin/PhotoAttributionFields.tsx src/components/admin/PhotoQueue.tsx src/components/admin/useGuideActions.ts src/components/map/pinnedMediaBoardStorage.ts src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx
npm run format:check
cd ..
git diff --check
EXPECTED=$(printf '%s\n' frontend/e2e/visual/admin-guide-detail-race.spec.ts frontend/e2e/visual/admin-guide-mutation-race.spec.ts frontend/e2e/visual/admin-place-photo-review-lock.spec.ts frontend/e2e/visual/admin-queue-race.spec.ts frontend/e2e/visual/memory-owner-delete-race.spec.ts frontend/src/components/admin/PhotoAttributionFields.tsx frontend/src/components/admin/PhotoQueue.tsx frontend/src/components/admin/useGuideActions.ts frontend/src/components/map/pinnedMediaBoardStorage.ts frontend/src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx | sort)
ACTUAL=$(git diff --name-only | sort)
test "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED"
git add -- frontend/e2e/visual/admin-guide-detail-race.spec.ts frontend/e2e/visual/admin-guide-mutation-race.spec.ts frontend/e2e/visual/admin-place-photo-review-lock.spec.ts frontend/e2e/visual/admin-queue-race.spec.ts frontend/e2e/visual/memory-owner-delete-race.spec.ts frontend/src/components/admin/PhotoAttributionFields.tsx frontend/src/components/admin/PhotoQueue.tsx frontend/src/components/admin/useGuideActions.ts frontend/src/components/map/pinnedMediaBoardStorage.ts frontend/src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx
git commit -m 'Format audited frontend changes'
SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
git push origin HEAD:"$BRANCH"
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$SHA"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
printf 'published_sha=%s\n' "$SHA"
